spans.s:
takram तक्रम्
Thin buttermilk
A type of buttermilk prepared by churning curd with quarter the amount of water.

takrakūrcikā तक्रकूर्चिका
Solid part of milk boiled with buttermilk
The solid portion obtained when milk is boiled with buttermilk.

ITA-9.2.20 takradhārā तक्रधारा
Controlled pouring of buttermilk over body
A procedure in which buttermilk is poured in a stream all over the body.
